#### PR description:

This PR adds in the missing dictionaries, and allows to reduce the overall memory allocation required by the generation of missing types on the fly.

Backport of #51739 (EgammaReco, L1TMuon), #52240 (EcalDigi, L1TMuonPhase2, L1TParticleFlow), #52241 (HGCalReco, StdDictionaries), #52244 (SimDataFormats/CaloAnalysis), forward-port of #52293
